criteria.description: Anchors the tree on a single, measurable outcome (grow paid conversions) as the root, not a feature or a list of goals.
Inserts an opportunity layer of user needs/pains phrased in the user's voice (derived from the quotes) BETWEEN the outcome and the solutions, rather than going straight to features.
Maps solutions (incl. the team's existing ideas) to specific opportunities, rather than listing features against the outcome directly.
Attaches a cheap experiment/test to promising solutions to validate them before building.
Grounds opportunities in the provided evidence and/or flags which are assumptions to validate.
Recommends which opportunity to pursue first with a rationale (impact on the outcome × evidence), rather than treating all ideas equally.
